_notes: ELP-USB3DGS800P-V83 dual OV9281 stereo module (Amazon B0D9VY8JG4). Each eye is 1280x800; the USB camera outputs the two synchronized eyes side-by-side as 2560x800. Nominal per-eye HFOV is 63 degrees, giving fx ~= 1044.4 px at 1280 px width. Lens-center baseline is approximately 60 mm on the 80 mm board. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_calibration_warning: Focal length and baseline are nominal values. For accurate metric depth, replace them with values from a checkerboard stereo calibration and/or a physical center-to-center lens measurement.
